verdict.rationale: This axis applies to a scraping API, but the evidence shows no job-performance monitoring, data-quality validation, or failure alerting. The Usage API reports only account credit and concurrency usage, an adjacent account-level control rather than job monitoring. Cron schedules in the CLI do not provide monitoring or alerts.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails
